name: Astrophobia
source:
Astrophobia centers two characters, you, Nova, and your wolf, Albert, as a rogue supermassive black hole hurtles through the solar system. Not much time left until your planet passes through the event horizon, what a way to cap off your honeymoon.

[From [url=https://l4putan-machin3.itch.io/astrophobia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《天体恐惧症》以两个角色为中心：你，诺瓦，和你的狼，艾伯特，当一个流氓超大质量黑洞冲过太阳系时。距离你们的星球穿过视界已经不多了，这是结束你们蜜月的好方法。

[来自[url=https://l4putan-machin3.itch.io/astrophobia]Itch.io[/url]]
